rationale: The parties have converged on the need for quantified, site-level analysis and on rejecting cosmetic compromise, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor/state reject closures and forced redundancies, while management/owners/investors still insist they remain possible. The last two rounds mostly restate hardened positions with only technical clarification from the expert, so the discussion is circling and needs an injected factual scenario model rather than another identical round.
